pages.title: What Is a Channel?
pages.text: Right-click any weapon to open its GUI. Four fire channels are available; click a "CH..." button to choose the weapon's active channel. A weapon can belong to only one active channel at a time.$(br2)The Control Seat HUD shows which channels are enabled; see $(l:vsie:control_seat/flying_information)Control Seat: HUD/$.$(br2)While seated, press 1/2/3/4 to toggle the corresponding channels; see $(l:vsie:control_seat/flying_control)Control Seat: Flight Controls/$.

A weapon must be linked to a Control Seat before it can operate; see $(l:vsie:control_seat/how_to_connect)Control Seat: Linking Peripherals/$. Once linked, it becomes active whenever its assigned channel is enabled on the Control Seat. Its abbreviation and cooldown appear on the right side of the HUD; see $(l:vsie:weapon/weapon_cooldown)Weapons: Cooldown/$.$(br2)Pressing the fire control fires every active weapon.
